basedOn: Morning prices of the demo catalogue
headline: Fresh Bhutai and Bangude lead today's Mangaluru catch
summary: Bhutai is plentiful today with 550 kg available at ₹160/kg. Premium fish like Maanji and Anjal are also fresh at the docks.

insights.title: Best Deal Below Average
insights.text: Bangude is at ₹210/kg today, lower than its week average of ₹225/kg across 3 boats.

insights.title: Pricier Than Usual
insights.text: Balchatte is ₹260/kg today, which is higher than its week average of ₹243/kg.

insights.title: Most Plentiful Supply
insights.text: Bhutai leads today's supply with 550 kg available at ₹160/kg from 2 boats.

insights.title: Grade A Premium Choice
insights.text: Maanji offers Grade A quality at ₹1100/kg with 28 kg brought in by 2 boats.

picks.label: Budget pick
picks.reason: At ₹160/kg with 550 kg available, it is an affordable choice for curry or rava fry.

picks.label: Family pick
picks.reason: Costing ₹210/kg, this Grade A catch serves 3–4 people and is great for tawa fry.

picks.label: Special occasion
picks.reason: Grade A Anjal at ₹950/kg serves 4 people perfectly for a festive tawa fry.

tip: Bhutai at ₹160/kg is ideal for rava fry or curry to serve 3–4 people.
